name: @unframework/toolchain-qwik
description: The qwik test toolchain: the checker and tsconfig that type-check every case's qwik golden output in one run (L4), and the oxlint config, with eslint-plugin-qwik as a JS plugin, that lints it (L5), beside the ESLint host on TypeScript 6 that runs the plugin's type-aware rules (@unframework/toolchain-qwik-eslint).
